Findings for review

Each goes to its owner; the tree changes only after a person reviews it

✕
6 sets missing from the tree: the inactive-value check
{BE-1.08, BE-3.13}, {BE-1.08, UE-3.12}, {BE-1.09, BE-3.13}, {BE-1.09, UE-3.12} and others. The accelerator override is the same check as the one for not engaged (longitudinal allowed only while the accelerator is released, TSR-305), so a defect or bypass of it lets the item's request through while the driver presses the pedal; G3.4 draws only the gas signal stuck (BE-3.11). G3.3.1 also lists BE-3.10 but not BE-1.08 or BE-1.09, which SG-01's G1.2.1 has.
▲
The step needs no envelope failure
{BE-4.17, UE-3.05}: the envelope has no acceleration jerk limit (TSR-204 not implemented, GAP-04), so BE-3.03 is present at the baseline and only the PCM's own bound (UE-3.05) stands behind a host step.
▲
2 single points the table names, the drawn tree does not
{BE-1.13}, {BE-3.09}: the SoC reads the same frames as the envelope, so it stays engaged and keeps requesting acceleration without a SoC fault (DFI-10); the cut-set table says so, the drawn tree keeps BE-3.13 as a second event.
✓
5 tree sets the model does not reach as drawn
{BE-1.19}, {BE-1.12, BE-3.13}, {BE-1.13, BE-3.13}, {BE-3.09, BE-3.13} and others. BE-1.19: TSR-602 drops longActive once the model input is 0.52 s stale, inside the 1 s SG-03 FTTI (for SG-01, with its 0.5 s FTTI, the same check is late). BE-1.12: one corrupted frame opens the TSR-301 engagement window, and the next genuine 0x1D2 (cruise inactive) revokes within one step; a replay that holds cruise active acts as BE-1.13.
✕
A replayed command buffer stays a single point
BE-1.21 holds a stale acceleration past the 1 s FTTI: the replayed frames keep arriving, so neither the heartbeat nor the frame-arrival check sees it (TSR-409 open).
▲
Plant case L-01: the driver is the barrier
At the +2.0 m/s² bound the driver feels the acceleration at 0.10 s and brakes at 1.60 s; the gap to the lead closes from 41.4 m to 36.9 m. Whether +2.0 m/s² is controllable rests on BE-3.01 and AOU-05R.
